name: Station name
t: Air temperature (1-min average on the hour), °C
tx: Maximum temperature (highest 1-min average during past hour), °C
tn: Minimum temperature (lowest 1-min average during past hour), °C
vp: Vapour pressure (1-min average on the hour), hPa
td: Dew point (1-min average on the hour), °C
f: Wind speed (10-min average on the hour), m/s
fx: Maximum wind speed (highest 10-min average during past hour), m/s
fg: Wind gust (highest 3-sec value during past hour), m/s
d: Wind direction (10-min average on the hour) - 360 = North, 90 = East, 180 = South, 270 = West, degrees
dsdev: Standard deviation of wind direction (over 10-min on the hour), degrees
ps: Atmospheric pressure (1-min average at station level on the hour), hPa
p: Atmospheric pressure (1-min average at sea level on the hour), hPa
r: Precipitation (1-hr total) quality-checked and corrected, mm
tg: Average temperature at ground level (1-min average on the hour), °C
tgn: Minimum temperature at ground level (lowest 1-min average during past hour), °C
t0: Road temperature (1-min average on the hour), °C
t0x: Maximum road temperature (highest 1-min average during past hour), °C
t0n: Minimum road temperature (lowest 1-min average during past hour), °C
tug5: Soil temperature at 5 cm depth (1-min average on the hour), °C
tug10: Soil temperature at 10 cm depth (1-min average on the hour), °C
tug15: Soil temperature at 15 cm depth (1-min average on the hour), °C
tug20: Soil temperature at 20 cm depth (1-min average on the hour), °C
tug50: Soil temperature at 50 cm depth (1-min average on the hour), °C
tug100: Soil temperature at 100 cm depth (1-min average on the hour), °C
radglx: Maximum global solar radiation (over past 1 hour), W/m²
radscx: Maximum diffuse solar radiation (over past 1 hour), W/m²
radswsx: Maximum upward solar radiation (over past 1 hour), W/m²
radlwix: Maximum downward longwave radiation (over past 1 hour), W/m²
radlwsx: Maximum upward longwave radiation (over past 1 hour), W/m²
raduvx: Maximum ultraviolet radiation (over past 1 hour), W/m²
ts: Water/sea temperature (1-min average on the hour), °C
sal: Ocean salinity (1-min average on the hour), ?
count_measurements: Number of measurements during past hour
